title: Exam day outage
summary: Five minutes into an online exam, the school's portal stops answering, and an extortion email arrives. Tell real students from attack traffic, name the three kinds of flood, and choose how to get the exam back.
ctf: The HTTP flood's user agent carries a flag (step 4). Submit it on the CTF board as "Exam day outage".

playbook.trigger: The exam portal returns 503 errors or times out
decisions: Restart the paper, or carry on?
targets: Ask the ISP for scrubbing within 15 minutes
Tell the exams board within 1 hour
notify: CERT-In within 6 hours of noticing it (2022 Directions)
Parents and students, in plain words
done: Scrubbing on and the portal stable
Rate limit added for the flood's pattern
Logs and the extortion email kept as evidence
